reply1:
**Draft:** The text is mostly clean. I replaced the em dash in 1/6 and straightened the curly apostrophes. In 5/6 I cut the staged "One of the lovely things about..." opener and stated the point directly. I kept the three-part thank-you in 4/6 because those are three real ways people helped. The numbered thread format is unchanged.

**Remaining patterns:** The "Maybe... Maybe..." pair in 5/6 is deliberate rhythm and fits a bookshop's warm voice, so I left it. The closing line of 4/6 is short but adds a little warmth, so I kept it.

<final>
1/6
The Tidewater Bookshop turns 10 this month. Ten years ago, we opened in a 400 sq ft space. Today, we have two floors of books, and an anniversary to celebrate.

2/6
400 sq ft meant making choices. Every shelf, every table, every book had to earn its place. We couldn't stock everything, but we could make a start.

3/6
Now we have two floors. Sometimes we think about that first little space and wonder how we ever fit a bookshop inside it. But we did, and you came through the door.

4/6
Thank you to everyone who has bought a book, recommended us to a friend, or stopped in to browse over the past decade. Those visits helped us get here.

5/6
After ten years, a book we sold when we first opened might still be sitting on someone's shelf. Maybe it's been reread. Maybe it's been passed along.

6/6
Our anniversary party is October 25. Come celebrate 10 years of The Tidewater Bookshop with us.

And if you remember the 400 sq ft days, we'd love to hear your memories.
</final>
